title: Document both bounds on the SQLite open retry during a store copy: the earlier of the copy deadline and one minute
outcome: Document both bounds on the SQLite open retry during a store copy: the earlier of the copy deadline and one minute
acceptance: docs/features/sqlite-store.md states that a store-copy open that keeps getting SQLITE_PROTOCOL retries until the earlier of the copy's capture deadline and one minute from the first retry, so an operator can read a backup refusal that ends near one minute with most of a 15-minute capture budget left
